metadata <- read_tsv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Metadata/Full_RSSC_Metadata_142_species.tsv") %>%   
  select(STRAIN, SEQTECH, "Host Order", PHYLOTYPE, "Host Family",
         "Year isolated", Species) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("STRAIN")




dist_genome <- read_tsv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Figure_2/Data/RSSC_jacc_dist.tsv",
                        show_col_types = FALSE,
                        col_names = c("g1", "g2", "jacc"))  


isol_dist_acc_grapple <- 
  read_tsv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/Pangenome/RSSC_sensitive_accessory_distance_grapple/RSSC_sensitive_accessory_distance_grapple_isols_matrix.tsv")

isol_dist_acc_grapple %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genome") %>% 
  pheatmap::pheatmap(.,
                     filename = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Supplementary_figs/Pheatmap_jacc_similarity_isolates_grapple.pdf",
                     width = 20,
                     height = 20,
                     annotation_col = metadata,
                     show_rownames = F,
                     border_color = NA)
